column3: Settled behind front group - 5th at halfway - urged into 4th 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong - edged in front close home and stayed on strongly to win
Sat behind front pair - third at halfway - urged into second spot over 2f out - hit front over 1f out - lost advantage 150 yards out but battled on for second
Held up towards the back - driven on inner approaching 2f out then moved to outer to reach 6th inside final furlong - stayed on well - claimed 3rd near the line
Sat behind front group early - urged forward approaching 2f out then found third with a furlong left - stayed on at same rate to the line - faded slightly in the closing strides to finish fourth
Sat behind front group early - 4th at halfway - urged into 3rd approaching 2f out - dropped back to 5th and stayed on one-paced through final furlong
Set the pace early - urged on approaching 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left and unable to quicken - dropped further back in the closing stages to finish 6th
Held up at back - urged into action approaching final 2f - driven with a furlong left - stayed on to take 7th near the line
Settled at the back - driven up on the inside from 2f out - plugged on from over 1f out to finish 8th
Settled midfield - driven approaching 2f out - unable to make ground and well held late
Sat handy behind front group - 6th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out and found nothing before dropping away late
Towards back of the pack - urged into effort with under 2f left - asked for more soon after but couldn't close - held no threat late and well beaten in 11th
Settled midfield - urged into contention entering straight - unable to land a blow from 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up early - lacked pace to challenge - well held at finish
Held up at the back throughout and well held
Sat close to pace early - second at halfway - driven approaching straight before fading two out to finish well beaten
Sat behind front pack - 5th at halfway - driven into 3rd approaching 2f out - hit the front inside final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Held up towards the back - driven wide approaching 2f out - improved into 5th with a furlong left - stayed on to snatch second at the line

Settled just behind front group - third at halfway - moved through to hit the front five furlongs out - driven on with two to go - overtaken a furlong from home - stayed on but couldn't find more and edged back to finish third

Settled midfield early - urged forward approaching 2f out and stayed on gamely under pressure inside final furlong - briefly up to 3rd near the finish - unable to find more and eased back to 4th at the line
Settled midfield early - crept onto the pace turning in - urged up into 5th two out - flashed to third with a furlong left before fading to finish fifth
Went straight to front - lost command approaching 5f out - fourth and driven 2f out - squeezed for space inside final furlong - found nothing more and dropped away late
Held up towards back - improved into midfield by halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but found little - stayed on at one speed to the line
Slow to break - settled midfield - asked for effort approaching 2f out - one-paced to the line finishing 8th
Sat close to front group early - 4th at halfway - boxed for room approaching 2f out then let up inside final furlong
Held up early - remained outpaced for most - finished down the field in 10th
Held up towards back of field - urged into effort on inner approaching 2f out - couldn't quicken from 1f out and well held at finish
Sat close to pace early - up in second by halfway - driven with two furlongs left then faded final furlong to finish 12th
Settled towards the back early - unable to build any threat - well held in 13th
Settled in the pack early - improved to sit close up by halfway - asked for effort turning into straight but found little - lost place over 2f out and well held late
Sat close up early - settled midfield by halfway - dropped away in the straight and eventually well held
Shared front spot early - moved clear approaching 3f out then edged further ahead 2f from home - driven out and stayed on strongly to the line
Settled midfield - urged forward outside over 2f out - moved into 4th inside final 2f - stayed on well to snatch second near the line

Sat behind the front pack early - third at halfway before being asked for effort to move into second 2f out - stayed on gamely into the final furlong - flattened out and dropped a spot near the line to finish third
Sat close to the front group - asked for effort entering straight - moved into 3rd over 2f out - held same rhythm to finish 4th
Held up towards back of the pack - urged forward wide over 2f out and moved into 6th with a furlong left - stayed on to take 5th close home
Sat close to the front group early - under pressure in 5th two out and unable to find more from a furlong out - dropped a spot near the finish to end sixth
Sat close to the front group early - urged into 6th with 2f left and unable to find more inside the final furlong - stayed on at same effort to finish 7th beaten 13 lengths
Held up in the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - responded and stayed on late to finish eighth
Sat close to the pace - 4th at halfway - asked for effort wide entering straight but had nothing more and dropped away 2f out
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from over 2f out - well held at the finish
Shared the front early - lost command after 3f and sat second at halfway - driven on turning for home - held safe in 4th over 2f out - dropped away in the closing stages to finish 11th
Held up early - unable to make an impression - well beaten in 12th
Held up at the back - no impression made on leaders - well beaten in 13th
Held up towards the back - urged forward entering the straight - dropped away from over 2f out - eventually well beaten in 14th
Slow to begin - held up at the back throughout - no impression made - finished last of the field well beaten
Held up towards the back - driven wide approaching 2f out - improved into third with a furlong left - swept clear 150 yards out and stayed on strongly
Settled behind pace - still in second at halfway - driven up to challenge 2f out - hit front with a furlong left - overtaken 150 yards from home but stayed on to the line
Set the pace early - driven and matched two out then slipped back to 4th with a furlong left - finished strongly to snatch 3rd in the final strides

Sat behind the front pair early - third at halfway - urged forward approaching 2f out and briefly second inside the final furlong - then found nothing and lost placings late finishing fourth after being squeezed for room
Held up in the pack - unable to make headway from 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled just behind the front pair - midfield turning in - asked for effort with 2f left - up into third a furlong out - swept past to lead late and score

Up with the front group in 3rd at halfway - nudged forward on the inner to advance into 2nd over 2f out - taken to the front over 1f out - challenged hard inside the final 50 yards and worn down near the line to finish 2nd
Took the lead - pressed and surrendered the advantage over 1f out - plugged on without finding more to finish 3rd
Tracked front-runner early - up to 2nd by halfway - dropped to 3rd and driven approaching final 2f - held on for 4th without finding more inside the closing stages
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - responded and stayed on late to snatch 5th near the line
Held up towards back of pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - driven and stayed on same gear inside final furlong - finished 6th
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort on the outside approaching 2f out - soon under pressure and unable to close from a furlong out - finished well held in 7th
Sat behind the front group - 4th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out with little response in 5th - dropped away final furlong to finish 8th
Held up in the pack from the off - no impression made - finished well beaten in 9th
Sat behind the front group - 5th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out with nothing more to offer - lost place near the finish
Held up at the back throughout - no impression made - finished well beaten in 11th
Held up towards back of pack - asked for effort out wide entering straight - soon dropped away and pulled up two furlongs out

Sent forward early and disputed no one - moved to front and edged left into open ground after 2f - opened a big margin by 3f - lead unchallenged approaching 3f out - asked for effort with 2f left - eased left and margin shrunk inside final furlong - overtaken close home - fought back to regain command - battled it out to prevail

Handy in the pack early - moved into second spot with 2f left - closed on the front-runner a furlong out and looked full of promise - pushed to the front inside the last - unable to hold on and caught close home
Slow into stride - quickly on terms with front group - moved left and roused approaching 2f out - up to third inside final furlong - kept responding but couldn't get to front two
Held up towards the back - made gradual progress but too much ground to make up over 2f out - pushed along and stayed on from inside the final furlong without the speed to get involved in the finish
Sat close to pace early - pushed on approaching 3f out - faded and dropped back over 2f out - shifted right and kept battling from the final furlong to finish fifth
Held up in the pack - angled right and pressed on approaching 2f out - stayed on without threatening late
Settled among the pack early - dropped back approaching 3f out - unable to close from 2f out - finished well held in 7th
Handy early - tracking front-runner from the 3f mark - driven from 4f out and lost ground under pressure inside final 2f
Slow into stride - settled towards back - unable to land a challenge - finished ninth beaten well clear of contention
Held up in the pack - urged forward 3f out - lost touch and dropped away final furlongs - well held at the finish
Settled second early on eager terms - pushed to the front after a furlong - driven and pressed by rival with a furlong left - stayed on well to the line - never in danger of being caught
Sluggish start at the back - travelled strongly in rear - improved and pushed along 2f out - boxed in briefly inside final furlong - kept battling to the line - denied narrowly by winner
Sent forward from the break - handed up soon after but stayed close - roused along with 2f left - challenged strongly approaching the final furlong - lost momentum near the line to come home third
Settled with the pace - pushed along over 2f out - stayed on late without threatening the front runners
Settled with the pack early - urged into contention 2f out - lost ground rapidly - trailed home well beaten in 5th

Settled just behind pace-setter early - drifted left over 1st - shared front spot from 4th - went clear from 5th and set fair pace - driven out and closely challenged approaching final two - kept finding more to prevail

Held up behind front pack early - improved to second before halfway - cruising in second turning for home - pressed for effort a furlong out but couldn't threaten winner - held on for second under sustained riding
Held up early - progress 4 out - 4th and jumped raggedly 2 out - up to 3rd inside final furlong and stayed on but never a factor
Settled towards the back - made progress 4 out - up to 4th 3 out and briefly 3rd - dropped back to 4th inside final furlong - held on for 4th without finding more
Up with the pace early - serious blunder at the 3rd - dropped right away from the 6th and finished a remote 5th
Set the pace and drifted left over obstacles - matched at the 4th - fumbled the 5th and lost command - pushed along but couldn't respond - back in last when came down 3 out
Settled just off the pace early - crept into contention over a furlong out - asked to go up approaching the final furlong - edged away inside the final furlong to score readily
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with two furlongs left - improved into second inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line but unable to reel in the winner
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left then found extra to move into third inside the final furlong - kept on to finish third
Settled in the pack - needed rousing approaching the 2f marker - made progress to reach fourth inside the final furlong - couldn't quite secure third
Went straight to front - pushed along a furlong out and lost command approaching the last furlong - dropped away in the closing stages to finish fifth
Urged from the off - up with the pace before finding little over 2f out - dropped away in the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled at the back of the field - urged forward with over two furlongs remaining - unable to threaten the front group - finished well beaten in 7th
Held up mid-pack - knocked about 4f out - moved into contention 3f out - driven approaching 2f out and put to test with a furlong left - dropped away rapidly to finish eighth
Held up close to the pace - dropped back under pressure inside the final 2f - faded from there to finish ninth
settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left - made no real impression - allowed to drop away late finishing 10th
Pulled hard early - settled mid-pack - drifted right with 4f left - pressed for effort 2f out and soon finished 11th
Sprinted to the front briefly early on - dropped to the back of the field - pushed along approaching final 2f but made no impression
Set the pace from the off - urged forward before four out - clear of rivals nearing the last - challenged for the advantage inside the final furlong - stayed on resolutely to prevail
Settled at the back - hampered 4 out - travelling well and closing on the front group approaching the last - moved into second inside the final 110yds - closest at the line

Settled in the pack - stumbled and a touch checked 4 out - moved up to share second approaching the last and challenged for the lead entering the final furlong - kept on at one speed and dropped to third inside the final 110yds
Settled in the pack - hit the 8th awkwardly - moved into second 4 out - level for the runner-up spot near the last - shaken up but edged out over a furlong out and faded
Held handy spot - travelling well - came down 4 out
Settled in the pack - pushed along when found wanting 8th - bumped and came unshipped 4 out
Held up towards the back - urged forward wide 2f out - 6th with a furlong left - stayed on to hit the front late and win
Settled behind the pace - third at the midpoint - urged forward turning in - hit front two out - held on until inside final furlong then edged out for second
Sat handy behind front group - moved into 2nd before 2f gone - asked for effort 2f out but found little in 3rd - stayed on same rate to finish third
Set the early pace - driven and overtaken approaching 2f out - kept safe in second under pressure inside final furlong - eased back to finish fourth
Sat close to the front group early - 5th at halfway - driven on the rail with 2f left - unable to find more inside final furlong and finished 5th beaten two lengths
Settled midfield - driven into 6th approaching final 2f with little response - stayed on same gait to finish sixth
Held up in the pack - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on late to take 7th near the finish
Settled around midfield - asked for effort out wide over 2f out with little response - stayed on at one gear through the final furlong to finish eighth
Sat behind front group early - 4th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out with nothing more to offer - faded inside final furlong to finish ninth
Held up towards the back - still there approaching straight - driven inside final two furlongs and edged through late for modest gains - finished 10th beaten 4½ lengths
Up with the front group early - towards the centre of the field at halfway - niggled on the inner over 2f out and making no inroads from over 1f out
Sat handy behind front group - midpack at halfway - driven approaching 2f out and gave way inside final furlong
Settled at the back early - unable to land a blow - well held in 13th
Settled at the back early - made no impression through the race - finished well held in 14th
Settled midpack early - held up for space approaching 2f out - found a gap and stormed clear inside final furlong - edged across and clipped another runner close home - stayed on strongly to score
Up with the pace - short of room over 2f out then angled left to challenge the head of affairs inside the final furlong - bumped under hands and heels - stuck on but denied close home
Set the pace early - urged along approaching 2f out and put under pressure inside the final furlong - dropped from second close home - unable to find more late
Took a strong hold early - up with the front group - under pressure and dropped back over 1f out - kept on without troubling those ahead

Towards the back of the pack early - lost touch approaching 4f out then rallied under pressure from 2f out - never able to land in the frame but kept plodding on from the final furlong to finish fifth
Settled towards the back - unable to land a blow - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed to improve 3f out and moved left 2f out - couldn't find any response inside final furlong and finished 7th well held
Settled in the pack early - urged forward and edged into contention 3f out then asked for effort 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish well beaten
Settled towards back of the field - lost touch approaching 3f out - unable to challenge and finished well beaten in 9th
Held up handy in the pack - pushed to keep tempo with 3f left - driven and dropped away inside final furlong - eventually well held
Held up at back - urged forward with three furlongs left - moved through into contention with two to go - powered clear inside the final furlong to score comfortably
Settled in the pack early - driven into contention and moved through 3f out - hit the front over a furlong out - overtaken close home but battled to the line
Held up at the back - pushed along and made progress from 2f out - moved left approaching final furlong - stayed on to the line but no impact on leading two
Settled in the pack early - driven to make progress 3f out - hampered for room 2f out and unable to threaten - stayed on late to finish fourth
Keen to go forward early - hit the front - driven and lost lead 3f out - under pressure with 2f left - held no chance from there and weakened into fifth
Sat close up early - hit front 3f out under urging - overtaken with over a furlong left - faded quickly - trailed home at the finish
Set the pace from the break - held wide berth throughout - pressed for effort a furlong out - kept finding more to assert late and win
Settled up with pace on far rail - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on gamely inside final furlong - runner-up behind clear leader
Handy early close to the front rank - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - edged left approaching the final furlong - held on at a steady gallop to the line
Held a forward spot near the stand rail early - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept on at one level through the closing stages - finished fourth beaten around six and a half lengths
Up with the pace on the far rail - pushed along 2f out - edged left under 1f out - fell away sharply in the closing stages - well held in 5th
Settled towards back on the near flank early - stayed off the pace for the duration - unable to make an impression - finished sixth
Settled on the near flank early - stayed off the pace throughout - unable to land a blow late on
Set the pace from the off - pushed clear approaching final furlong - driven out to hold on for the win
Settled behind the front group - asked for effort to move into second 2f out - stayed on well final furlong - edged out into second at the line
Held up in the pack - pushed along approaching 2f out - ran on to grab third near the line - third at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left and briefly up to third with a furlong to go - slipped back and held for fourth close home
Jumped well at the off - settled at the back of the field - nudged forward 2f out and made some late headway - always too far adrift to trouble the principals
Settled at back of field - driven approaching final two furlongs - nudged into slightly better position final furlong but made no real impression - finished sixth well beaten
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - unable to land a challenge - finished seventh
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f remaining - unable to land a blow inside final furlong - well beaten in 8th
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - faded soon after - well held at the finish
Settled close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong
Slow to break - restrained towards the back - made no impression when roused 2f out
Settled towards the back - still travelling nicely nearing the last - asked for effort and closed on the front-runner into the final furlong - stayed on strongly to hit the front close home
Settled in the pack early - closed on the front group before the last then pushed to the front entering the final furlong - fought on but overtaken close home to finish second
Handy early - shared front spot at the 9th - eased back to third entering the last furlong under pressure and stayed on at an even effort to finish third
Held up mid-pack - clipped first fence - close enough to front group but stumbled at last - pushed along over a furlong out and weakened close home

Settled close to pace early - edged onto front rank before 3rd then blundered heavily and dropped away 6th - driven along towards back through midfield before 2 out - unable to quicken approaching last - nudged a shade closer inside final furlong - finished fifth
Settled at back of field - still in contention approaching the last - lost ground in closing stages to finish sixth
Travelled strongly early - shared front spot before 3rd then disputed again 9th - pushed along before 3 out - lost place late and dropped away final furlong to finish 7th
Handy in behind early - third at halfway - driven into second spot with two furlongs left - hit front a furlong out under urging - challenged hard in closing yards to hold on
Shared front spot early - kicked clear over 2f out - overhauled inside final furlong - fought back close home to go down by a whisker
Settled in the pack early - urged into 6th 2f out - improved to 4th inside final furlong - stayed on to snatch 3rd near the line
Held up towards the back - improved into 4th by halfway - driven wide approaching final 2f - forced into 3rd inside final furlong - held on same rate then edged back to 4th late
Prominent early and shared the front - driven and slipped back to 3rd approaching 2f out then unable to find more in 5th with a furlong left - stayed on same gait to finish 5th
Settled just behind the front group - 5th at halfway - asked for effort approaching last two furlongs but found little in 6th - lost ground inside final furlong to finish sixth
Held up early - stayed in touch of the pack throughout - no impression made on the leaders - well held at the finish
Held up early - remained detached through the contest - no impression made - finished well beaten in 8th
Held up at the back - made no impression - well held in 9th
Set pace from the outset - opened a big advantage inside the last 3f - urged forward approaching the final 2f - stayed on strongly to the line unopposed
Held up in the back markers - driven into contention 3f out - moved up to second before the last two furlongs - unable to challenge in front and stayed on at one tempo to finish runner-up
Settled in midpack early - eased left and made ground from 4f out - up to third with 2f left - stayed on late without matching the leaders' speed to finish third
Up with the front group - pushed forward over 5f out - gradual progress to 4f out - under pressure 3f out - drifted right and dropped away from 2f out
slow into stride - settled at back of field - unable to land a blow through finish
Settled in the pack early - pushed for effort with 3f remaining - never able to land a blow on the front rank from 2f out - well held at the finish
Prominent early - pushed for effort over 4f out - dropped away 3f out - soon well held and trailed home last
Sluggish start - dropped to rear and lost touch inside 2f - never in contention thereafter
Well placed wide early - dropped away over 4f out - faded rapidly and finished last
Close to the pace early - dropped away past 4f out - driven and faded from 3f out to finish well beaten
Reared at the break - set off in front - held the lead throughout without a serious threat - home comfortably
Settled up with the pace early - checked out and pushed back 3f out - pressed for effort with 2f left - responded gamely inside the final furlong - closed to be second without threatening the winner

Settled in the pack - moved up 3f out - pressed for effort with 2f left and angled left approaching the furlong pole - closed on the leader inside the last but couldn't find more and edged out for second near the line
Held up at the back - pressure applied from 3f out - stayed on inside the final furlong without threatening - finished 4th
Stumbled leaving stalls - settled towards the back - driven into contention 2f out - steered left approaching final furlong - stayed on through the closing stages - held for fifth at the line
Hampered at the break - settled in the pack - niggled along and brushed another runner 3f out - drifted left over a furlong out - held on for sixth without finding more late
Sat close up early - urged into effort 3f out - driven with two to go - form gave way soon after and faded to finish seventh
Settled in the pack early - asked for effort 3f out and again 2f out - knocked back and beaten to last approaching final furlong - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back of the pack early - made progress from 2f out - driven into the advantage inside the final furlong - edged away near the finish - won going away
Handy early - edged to front after 2f - pressed for effort over 2f out and gave way inside final furlong - kept going to the line for second
Took a strong hold early - sat handy behind the pace - asked for effort 3f out and improved to challenge inside final furlong - stayed on well to finish third
Settled in the pack - improved into contention 4f out - pressed for effort 3f out - stayed on gamely - held no threat at the finish
Settled in the pack - ridden and challenging for the front over 1f out - faded inside the final furlong to end fifth
Eager early - up with the pace - nudged for effort 2f out - quickly dropped by the front rank - stayed on inside the last without threatening - sixth beaten over 8 lengths
Held up eagerly early - settled mid-pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - edged into contention inside the final furlong - weakened close home to finish seventh
Held up eagerly early - tracked mid-pack - driven approaching 3f out - dropped away inside final 2f and held on without gaining finishing eighth
Settled towards back of field - unable to land a blow - well held at finish
Held up towards the back - lost touch and pushed along 2f out - stayed on at one gait but always held
Held up towards back of pack - couldn't land a blow - finished well held in 11th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Held up early pulling hard - settled towards back of field - never got competitive - well held at finish
Held up close to the front - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 14th
Held up at the back - no impact in the contest - well beaten in 15th
Took a strong hold early - sat close to the pace - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away rapidly in the closing stages to finish well beaten
Sat close up in second early - hit the front from the fifth then pushed along after the second-last - kept finding under pressure to score
Settled midpack early - stumbled 4th fence but held position handy - up to 3rd four out - pushed into 2nd two out and stayed on for the runner-up spot
Sat close behind front group early - pushed along in 3rd approaching 2 furlongs out - stayed on at one speed to the line finishing 3rd
Towards the back early - fifth of six approaching the fourth last and still there at the third - under pressure from 2 out - kept on at one pace for 4th inside the final furlong
Sat close to the pace early - third with three furlongs left before pushed into fourth at the final furlong marker - unable to close from there
Set the pace early - stumbled first and lost momentum at the 4th - lost front spot 5th and needed encouragement - held in 5th place after 4 out before fading late
Held up towards rear early - urged into contention around 7th - unable to land a blow - well held in 7th
Handy early - driven up to challenge with a furlong left - hit the front inside final 110yds and kept going to win
Wide early - into a forward spot after a furlong - roused to hit the front 2f out - challenged inside final furlong - overhauled close home and just denied
Settled just off the pace - driven into contention over 2f out and up to third inside the final furlong - kept going to finish third
Held up mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left - kept coming late but never a factor for the front - finished fourth
Settled mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to sustain effort inside final furlong - finished 5th
Settled just off the pace - pressed for a run inside the final furlong - unable to land a blow - finished sixth beaten 5 lengths
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - soon dropping away - well held at the line
Pulled hard towards the back of the field - pushed along 2f out - well out of it throughout to finish 8th
Set the pace early - lost command 2f out - pushed along and dropped away quickly - well held at the finish

Front early but harried into second at the 7th - tracking the pace back up with 2 out - pushed forward to challenge approaching the last - in front over 2f out and four lengths to the good entering the final furlong - margin narrowed late but won with something in hand
Held up in the pack - driven and 15 lengths off the pace approaching the final fence - stayed on to snatch second inside the closing furlong but couldn't get to the winner
Settled at the back early - mistake 5th - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on into third approaching the last furlong - unable to get to the front two
Sat close to the front - edged narrowly clear 2 out - challenged for the top spot nearing the last - needed urging - overtaken inside final 2f - well adrift entering the last furlong and faded
Held up in rear throughout - never able to challenge - finished 5th
Up with the pace - urged along 2f out - pressed for control over 1f out - asserted inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly
Handy early - hit front strongly over 2f out - put under pressure and overtaken inside final furlong - battled on for second
Sent clear early - overtaken and dropped back approaching 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong - fought back to grab third close home
Held up towards back of field - lost touch and driven on 3f out - work needed with a furlong left - found some late improvement without threatening the front - finished fourth
Settled in behind early - made ground under pressure approaching final 2f - unable to close on front group - held on for fifth without finding more late
Pulling hard early - close behind the front group - pressed for effort 2f out then found little inside final furlong - held on for sixth
Slow to break - settled at back of field - made no impression - finished seventh beaten four lengths
Took early command - pressed for effort with over 2f left and lost front spot - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 8th
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed for effort with 2f left before dropping away inside the final furlong - finished ninth
Stood up early - settled quickly to hit front before the 1f marker - set the pace throughout - never seriously tested - scored with plenty in hand
Held up at the back early - driven into contention 3f out - asked for effort 2f out - kept on inside the final furlong - grabbed second late but no threat to winner
Tracked front-runner - pushed along 3f out - held effort inside final furlong but couldn't quicken and yielded second close home
Sat close to the pace - pressed for effort with 3f left - stayed on late but held to fourth
Sluggish start - settled towards back of pack - pushed along 3f out - progress from 2f out - held effort through closing stages - unable to quicken near finish and held on for fifth
Held up in the pack - pushed along and made progress into contention 3f out - stayed on at one gear inside final furlong to finish sixth
Held mid-division early - urged to improve inside final 3f - lacked the speed to get involved late
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort and lost touch approaching 3f out - unable to threaten the front end thereafter
Held up towards the back - pushed along and losing touch 3f out - unable to threaten leaders and slipped to last approaching the final furlong
Settled towards the back of the pack near the stand rail - pushed along with 3f left - moved through from there - took over close home inside the final furlong - stayed on to prevail
Early into the contest on the far flank - travelled close up - pushed to the front two out - overtaken but battled on inside the final furlong - edged out close home
Held up handy on the near rail - into contention approaching 2f out with urging - lost place inside final furlong - held on for third without finding more
